explanation: This is 0 everywhere except at D2 in late trials (about trial 83 onward) when the previous trial was unrewarded: there it hits about 10 if the agent chose a1 and got a rare transition to S2, and about 6-9 if it reached S1 normally (common). It stays 0 at all D1 and GO steps, after rewarded trials, before about trial 80, and on the trial right after a rare unrewarded trial (that one may read 0-2).
